labelChirho: to take in pledge, hold as security
descriptionChirho: To take or hold property as a pledge or security for a debt — the act of seizing collateral from a debtor, including both the active taking and the state of being pledged (Exod 22:26; Deut 24:6,17; Job 22:6; 24:3,9; Prov 20:16; 27:13; Ezek 18:16; Amos 2:8)
